dos.text: Use supportPage for internal SUMO articles rather than passing that URL through href, render() branches on supportPage first and renders the is="moz-support-link" anchor exclusively, completely ignoring href when both are set.

donts.text: Don't expect the href-based link to stay in the current tab, the template hardcodes target="_blank" on that anchor with no property to override it, so it always opens a new tab/window.
